note: Legal Freelance pipeline scrape, 7-day window. 6 new leads (3 Grade A, 3 Grade B), all scoring 65+. Deduped against legal-freelance-, pr-freelance-, and daily-scrape reports from 2026-05-15 through 2026-05-21. Excluded this cycle: Lyfecoin Fractional GC (equity-only/deferred cash comp — fails comp-credibility and ICP 'not unpaid' filter); Transamerica Investment Funds Senior Counsel (stale Feb-2025 full-time direct hire); multi-family-office GC (full-time direct hire, low freelance intent). Two top sources (Latitude Legal, Robert Half Legal) recur from prior cycles but the specific postings/role IDs here are new. LinkedIn was not scraped directly — postings surfaced via Google/Bing-indexed results, firm career pages, and ACC Jobline.

leads.name: Ropes & Gray — Funds Attorney, Asset Management Group (Remote, Hourly Flexible Engagement)
leads.industry: Am Law 100 law firm — Asset Management / Private Funds group, flexible remote attorney program (hourly billable)
leads.compensationText: Hourly, compensated for billable work (rate not stated)
leads.employmentTypeRaw: Flexible/remote attorney program — 100% remote, paid hourly on billable work
leads.notes: Combined 85 / Grade A — hottest lead this cycle. Dead-center on Katie's premium fund lane: Asset Management / private-funds work at a top-tier firm, 100% remote, hourly/flexible. The hourly-billable structure is exactly the high-judgment, part-time operator model Katie targets. Comp model stated (hourly) but no rate, so comp_credible=0; everything else is full marks on fund focus + remote + flexible engagement. Pitch fund formation + fund-maintenance + LP/GP side-letter reps; position as overflow/specialist capacity for the AM group. Apply via Ropes & Gray flexible-attorney recruiting page.

leads.fundingStage: Established staffing firm; end-client investment platform / fund sponsor
leads.compensationText: Not stated (Robert Half contract placement; typically market hourly)
leads.notes: Combined 85 / Grade A. Fund formation + investment structuring is squarely in Katie's ICP, and the contract/remote engagement model is ideal. Citation is the Robert Half corporate-counsel board (the specific req rotates and was surfaced via the board + indexed snippet) — confirm freshness and pull the live req ID when applying.
